verses.1: And there was one who said, Hosea.
verses.2: And there was one who said, Gideon.
verses.3: And there was one who said, Samson, and Barak, and Deborah, and Judith, whether by women or by men; he raised up for them judges, that he might deliver them from those who oppressed them, and that he might save them from the hand of all their enemies.
verses.4: And according as he willed, God delivered them from those who oppressed them.
verses.5: And they rejoiced exceedingly in all that he multiplied for them in the seed of their land, and he increased their cattle, and in every pasture that was in the field and in the wilderness.
verses.6: And he blessed for them their cattle and their plants, and all that they possessed, both of the house and of the field; he blessed them, and their cattle did not fail, for with his eyes he watched over them, and he loved them exceedingly, for they were the generation of the righteous.
verses.7: But when they themselves became evil in their deeds, he delivered them into the hand of their enemies.
verses.8: And when he slew them, in the morning they sought him, and they repented and returned to the Lord God, their Creator.
verses.9: And when they repented with all their heart, he forgave them, and their former sins he did not remember against them, for he knew that they were flesh and blood, and that the thought of this world and of demons led them astray.
verses.10: And this Meqabis, when he heard this word which God had ordained on the mountain of his sanctuary, strove in repentance.
verses.11: And he did not cease from what he had seen and heard, this word, and concerning all the good things which the children of Israel did; for they provoked God, and when God was wroth with them because they transgressed his commandment, they wept and mourned, and again they besought him and did his commandment.
verses.12: And likewise Meqabis also kept his way straight, and kept his commandment, and walked in the commandment of the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.13: From that day when he heard, and in all that the children of Israel counseled him, likewise he conducted himself in keeping the commandment of the Lord.
verses.14: And he ordered his house and his children, that they should walk in all his ways and his commandments, the commandments of the Lord.
verses.15: And the things forbidden to the Jews which they held as forbidden, he also held as forbidden; and the commandments which the Jews kept, according to what he heard, likewise he did; and the foods which the Jews held as forbidden, he held as forbidden, though he himself was a stranger, a Moabite people.
verses.16: And tithes he tithed, and the firstborn of his sheep and his cattle and his herds, and all that he reaped he gave; and the offerings which the Jews offered, likewise he offered, turning toward the face of Jerusalem.
verses.17: And that which was for transgression and that which was for sin, and freewill offerings, and sacrifices of salvation, and sacrifices of thanksgiving.
verses.18: And the firstfruits, and the contributions which the Jews brought out, likewise he brought out and gave to the Levite who was appointed; and all that the Jews did, likewise he did, and the burning of incense.
verses.19: And he made curtains and veils and tables and layers and bowls and basins and cups, vessels for the holy places, and censers, that they might minister in the holy of holies of Israel, when they made supplication to the Lord.
verses.20: For they lived in his law and in his ordinance, and when God did not abandon them and did not deliver them into the hand of their enemies, likewise Meqabis walked uprightly in all his ways.
verses.21: And he prayed at all times to the Lord, the God of Israel, that he would be merciful to him and not destroy him from the congregation of Israel, whom he had chosen and whose will he had done.
verses.22: And again he prayed that he would give him seed in Zion and children in Jerusalem, and that he would save him from death, as it was spoken by the mouth of the prophet, and that his repentance might be established in all that he had repented of.
verses.23: And he wept before God with tears, that he might not destroy his seed from the earth, and that he would preserve him in his going out and his coming in.
verses.24: And from the peoples of Moab also, who were under the hand of Meqabis, he caused them to turn, that they might believe; for his messengers walked in a straight way, and they judged judgment and did his will, and they executed justice in their cities, and their land was at peace, and they saw that he walked uprightly, and the way of Meqabis prospered greatly.
verses.25: And they came to him and heard the judgment of his righteousness and his goodness, that of Meqabis.
verses.26: And he had many mules and servants and maidservants and herds and camels, and he had horses which wore armor.
verses.27: And from the day that he served the Lord, when he went into battle, there was none who prevailed over him; without him, none prevailed.
verses.28: And they came with the power of their gods, that they might fight against him and curse him in the name of their gods; but there was none who prevailed over him, for he had set his trust upon the Lord his God.
verses.29: And he continued doing thus, and he prevailed over his enemies and subdued the peoples under his hand.
verses.30: And he pled the cause of the oppressed, and judged righteously the cause of the orphans.
verses.31: And he supported the widows and the orphans with his sustenance, and he fed the hungry from his bread, and he clothed the naked from his clothing.
verses.32: And he rejoiced in his deeds and in the work of his hands, and he gave of what he had without withholding, and tithes he gave to the house of God; and while Meqabis was doing these things, he fell asleep in peace.
